objective: Al terminar hablas de salud, das consejos y explicas reglas y prohibiciones en inglés.

warmup.prompt_es: Checkpoint de la unidad 6: junta el vocabulario de salud, should, have to / must y las normas.

input.recap_es: Repasa: partes del cuerpo y síntomas, hablar con un médico, should / shouldn't, have to / don't have to / must / mustn't y can't / allowed to.

md_es: - *My back hurts. · I've got a sore throat and a cough.*
- *What's the matter? · Take it twice a day.*
- *You should rest. · You shouldn't drink coffee at night.*
- *You have to wear a uniform. · You don't have to buy it. · You must be on time. · You mustn't smoke.*
- *You can't park here. · You aren't allowed to take photos.*

exercises.prompt: I've got a sore ___ and a cough.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Sore throat = dolor de garganta.
Revisa esto: Consejo: should + verbo base.

exercises.prompt: You ___ have to bring food. It's free. (no hace falta)

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! No es necesario: don't have to.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: No es necesario: don't have to.

exercises.prompt: Une cada ordinal en cifras con su palabra.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Los ordinales irregulares hay que memorizarlos.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Los ordinales irregulares hay que memorizarlos.

options: You aren't allowed to park here.
You don't allowed to park here.
answer: You aren't allowed to park here.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Be allowed to + verbo base.

exercises.prompt: Tu amigo está resfriado. Le dices con educación:
options: I think you should stay in bed.
answer: I think you should stay in bed.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! I think you should… suaviza el consejo.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: I think you should… suaviza el consejo.

exercises.prompt: Hay un error. Escribe la frase correcta.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Resfriado = a cold; constipated = estreñido.

exercises.prompt: Hay un error. Escribe la frase correcta.
exercises.text: You should to drink more water.

exercises.audio_text: You must wear a helmet, but you don't have to pay for it. You can borrow one at the entrance.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Dice 'you don't have to pay for it'.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Dice 'you don't have to pay for it'.

exercises.audio_text: I'm not working now. I'm playing the guitar.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Dice 'I'm playing the guitar'.

exercises.prompt: Compraste ya las entradas y le cuentas tu plan a una amiga:
options: I'm going to see a film tonight.
I might to see a film.
answer: I'm going to see a film tonight.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Plan ya decidido: be going to.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Plan ya decidido: be going to.

exercises.prompt: Me duele el estómago y no debo comer.
answer: My stomach hurts and I mustn't eat.
My stomach hurts and I must not eat.
My stomach hurts and I shouldn't eat.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Hurts para el dolor; mustn't / shouldn't para 'no debo'.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Hurts para el dolor; mustn't / shouldn't para 'no debo'.

exercises.prompt: Se dice 'Did you went to the party?'.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Después de did, el verbo se queda en base: Did you go?
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Después de did, el verbo se queda en base: Did you go?

exercises.prompt: Hay un error. Escribe la frase correcta.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! El verbo va justo después del sujeto.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: El verbo va justo después del sujeto.

exercises.prompt: Escribe 5 frases: qué síntoma tienes, un consejo para ti mismo y una regla que tienes que cumplir en tu trabajo o estudio.
self_check_es: ¿Usaste have to o don't have to?
¿Usaste must o mustn't para una regla?
exercises.model_answer: I've got a headache and a cough. I think I should go to bed early. I have to wear a uniform at work, but I don't have to start early. I mustn't use my phone in class.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Compara tu texto con el modelo y la lista de control.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Compara tu texto con el modelo y la lista de control.

turns.speaker: You
choices: I've got a sore throat and a cough. I feel terrible.
I have sore of throat and cough.
turns.why_es: Describes los síntomas con I've got…

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: You should rest and drink lots of water.

turns.speaker: You
choices: Thank you. Do I have to take any tablets?
turns.why_es: Do I have to…? pregunta bien la obligación.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Practica diciendo en voz alta tu parte.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Practica diciendo en voz alta tu parte.
